item.title: Show HN: Recruiting/interview tool for recs, hiring managers and interviewers
item.summary: I do see that a lot of startups here are hiring. I would like to introduce a simple tool that can save a lot of time for you and your team. Last Friday I was on the panel with 2 other folks to do an interview. My boss asked me to focus on a specific area while he asked the other two to focus on two other areas. One hour total. You have to be super efficient with the few questions you get to ask and be fair as well. I used TopRec.io. Dropped the JD and resume and boom! In seconds I get a strength vs gaps analysis and a discrepancy check. Also "Chat with resume" feature (like ChatGPT) helped me find out what I could ask for my focus area - distributed systems and event driven architecture in the context of his experience combining these with Adobe MarTech platform. No trick questions but highly efficient ones hyper tailored to really see if the person had done what they claim in resume. This saved me 15-30 mins of my time during a very busy day, as I take the responsibility very seriously. It adds up when a team member has to do say 3-4-5 interviews a week. For hiring managers it can be a lot worse as they would first talk to all shortlisted candidates from the recruiter. Now imagine
